name: qfd_cst_n-st1-465253000
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v3 slot cell qfd_cst_n (384 instances; corridor station, north half: in b (S), out a (N) + tap (W)): first slot-shaped view under the die master name (today: legacy M8 view / the closed M5 route qfd_cst_m5 of ot_qwen_die_station, other cell name, clock on a data face). Body = ot_qwen_die_station unchanged (pure registers, every port a flop at its pin, 1020 sinks on one root); outline 52.68 x 103.656, pins M5 (N/S) / M4 (E/W), clock ck on N, cap M5.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_cst_n #(.DW(508)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_station_slots.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_station.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: station_exact
bench.note: 20,000 random words + random readies through the cell's own ports: every data output == input one cycle later (508 bits exact), upstream ready == AND of downstream readies two cycles later

bench.name: station_mutant
bench.note: OT_QFD_STATION_MUT inverts one data bit of the tap / north output inside the cell
